messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York City right now. You can check a reliable world clock or your device’s time settings for the most accurate information.
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "What is the current time in New York City?" We need to provide the current time. We don't have a function for time. We can compute using knowledge? But we don't have real-time data. We can approximate based on UTC offset. But we don't know current UTC. We could say "I don't have real-time capability." But maybe we can use the weather_forecast_get function with location "New York City" and hour? That function returns weather forecast, not time. So not relevant.

We should respond that I cannot provide real-time data. Or we can approximate if we had current UTC. But we don't. So best to say I can't provide real-time.
